title: Design System: MacHub
platform: macOS 15+ SwiftUI (dark only). Values are SwiftUI points; CSS in components is a 1 pt = 1 px preview approximation.

house-surface.canonical: Color.white.opacity(0.06) // Theme.surface; composites to #1A1A1C on the ground

display.purpose: Each title's Steam logo art is the display voice; SF Pro Expanded Heavy 52 pt only when logo art is unavailable. Theme.titleFont(52).

title.purpose: Row headings, detail section headings, empty-state heading.

summary.purpose: Hero summary (3 lines, 520 pt) and detail About text.

action.purpose: Play and secondary capsule button labels.

meta.purpose: Meta line, PlayStatus captions, full compatibility badge (semibold).

label.purpose: Compact badges, Demo data tag, sidebar status headline.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Only while a card is hovered or focused, Reduce Motion off.

shadows.name: logo-on-art
shadows.purpose: Light logo art placed directly over artwork.

shadows.name: logo-plate
shadows.purpose: Under the light Logo Plate behind dark logo art.

shadows.name: floating-glass
shadows.value: macOS 26: .glassEffect(.regular, in: .rect(cornerRadius: r)); earlier: .background(.ultraThinMaterial, in: .rect(cornerRadius: r))
shadows.purpose: Material, not shadow: only controls floating over artwork (featured strip 14, page dots 12, flask disc 12 on a 24 pt circle, bottle chip 6).

motion.name: card-lift
motion.purpose: Card hover/focus lift. Disabled under Reduce Motion; focus ring (3 pt white) still shows.

motion.name: hero-dwell
motion.purpose: Hero auto-advance; hover pauses and rewinds; off under Reduce Motion.

motion.name: hero-crossfade
motion.purpose: Hero slide change (art and text column).

motion.name: ambient-crossfade
motion.purpose: Ambient backdrop follows the spotlighted title.

motion.name: artwork-load
motion.purpose: AsyncImage phase change when Steam artwork arrives.

motion.name: row-page
motion.purpose: Row pager scroll (3 landscape / 5 portrait cards per step).

breakpoints.name: hero-strip
breakpoints.value: ViewThatFits: 112x52 pt thumbs -> 84x39 pt thumbs -> page dots

components.name: Play Button
components.description: The only Projector Red element. Live when a real Whisky install can launch the title.

components.name: Play Button (disabled)
components.description: Demo or unlaunchable title: fill at 35%, control at 55%, with the reason beneath.
components.html: Demo title. Install it in a Whisky bottle to play.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Details, Steam page, Show files: House Surface Raised capsule.

components.name: Compatibility Badge (verified)
components.description: Real verdict: tint at 14% fill, symbol plus label.
components.html: Runs great

components.name: Compatibility Badge (demo)
components.description: Illustrative demo value: outlined at 45% tint, leading grey flask, never filled.
components.html: Runs great

components.name: Demo Data Tag
components.description: Marks demo rows, the Library heading and the hero meta line.
components.html: Demo data

components.name: Title Card (portrait, demo)
components.description: 176x264 pt artwork, 10 pt corners, glass flask disc, name and compact outlined badge; lifts on hover/focus.

components.name: Featured Strip
components.description: Liquid Glass tray of hero thumbnails; current one bordered white with the 9 s dwell progress bar.

components.name: Whisky Status Chip
components.description: Foot of the sidebar: state dot in a compatibility tint, real Whisky version and bottle count; opens Settings.

components.name: Ambient Backdrop
components.description: Signature move: the spotlighted title's hero art, blurred (80), saturated 1.25, darkened 0.15, at 22% over Theatre Ground under a vertical ground gradient; cross-fades 0.8 s.
components.css: .ds-ambient{font-family:-apple-system,'SF Pro Text',system-ui,sans-serif;position:relative;width:320px;height:200px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:#0B0B0D}.ds-ambient-art{position:absolute;inset:-40px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 40%,#E81318,transparent 55%),radial-gradient(circle at 75% 30%,#7FB6E0,transparent 50%);filter:blur(40px) saturate(1.25) brightness(.85);opacity:.22;transition:opacity .8s ease-in-out}.ds-ambient:hover .ds-ambient-art{opacity:.3}.ds-ambient-veil{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(11,11,13,.7),transparent 33%,rgba(11,11,13,.85) 66%,#0B0B0D)}.ds-ambient-label{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:14px;color:#A8A8A8;font-size:12px}

narrative.overview:
MacHub is a dark theatre for a game library. The house lights are down: a warm near-black ground, surfaces that are nothing more than white breathed onto it at 6 to 10 percent, and native macOS chrome that stays out of the way. The colour in the room comes from the screen, which is each title's own Steam artwork: full-bleed in the hero, cropped into cards in the rows, and blurred into the whole window ground behind everything. The interface supplies only one colour of its own, the projector red of Play, and a set of honest compatibility signals.

The system is native first. It is a SwiftUI `NavigationSplitView` with the system floating sidebar, system pickers, a grouped `Form` for Settings, SF Symbols for every icon, and the graphite accent for every system control. The custom layer is narrow and deliberate: the hero, the cards, the compatibility badge, the demo treatment, and the ambient backdrop. The app forces dark appearance (`.preferredColorScheme(.dark)`), because light would wash the artwork out.

Honesty is visual. Demo content is always outlined and marked with a flask; it is never filled the way a verified state is filled. Play is only red when it can really launch something; otherwise it dims and a plain sentence beneath it says why.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black warm ground; white-alpha surfaces; no tinted greys.
The artwork carries the colour. Each title's Steam logo art is the display voice.
One interface colour, projector red, reserved for Play.
Five compatibility states, each a colour plus an SF Symbol plus a word.
Demo data is outlined, flasked and tagged, never filled.
Liquid Glass only on controls floating over artwork.
The ambient backdrop: the focused title's art bleeds, blurred, into the whole window.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Projector Red fills the Play button and nothing else. No red headings, red badges, red focus rings or red hover states. "Won't run" uses its own warmer red-orange (#FF453B), never #E50914.

rules.name: The House Lights Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are white at 6% or 10% over the ground, never an opaque grey and never tinted. Depth in the content area comes from alpha, the artwork and the scrims.

rules.name: The Three-Part Signal Rule
rules.body: A compatibility state is always tint plus SF Symbol plus label. If one of the three is missing, it is not a compatibility state.

rules.name: The Borrowed Marquee Rule
rules.body: A title's name is shown in its own logo art wherever the hero or detail page names it. SF Pro Expanded is the fallback and the voice of MacHub's own page titles, never a replacement for available logo art.

rules.name: The Light Plate Rule
rules.body: Logo art whose visible pixels average below 0.35 luminance (alpha-weighted, sampled on a 24 × 24 grid) sits on the Logo Plate: 18 pt × 12 pt padding, 14 pt corners, soft shadow. Light logos sit directly on the art with a soft drop shadow. Dark two-tone wordmarks such as Assetto Corsa's must stay readable over any artwork.

rules.name: The One Gutter Rule
rules.body: Content aligns to the 44 pt gutter. A custom page with a second left edge is off-system.

rules.name: The Glass Over Art Rule
rules.body: Glass is for controls sitting on artwork. Panels on the ground use House Surface; glass never fills a plain panel.

rules.name: The Lift Is a Response Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels cast no shadow at rest. The card shadow exists only while the card is lifted; the only resting shadows are the soft ones that separate logo art from the artwork behind it.

dos: Do reserve Projector Red (#E50914) for the Play button's fill.
Do build every surface as white at 6% (House Surface) or 10% (House Surface Raised) over Theatre Ground, and every hairline as white at 10%.
Do show compatibility as tint + SF Symbol + label, using the five `Compatibility` cases and nothing else.
Do mark every piece of demo content with all three demo devices: outlined badge, flask disc on the card, "Demo data" tag on the row or page.
Do let each title's Steam logo art carry its name in the hero and on detail, on the Logo Plate when it is dark.
Do use the two card sizes (landscape 296 × 138 pt, portrait 176 × 264 pt) with 10 pt corners, and align content to the 44 pt gutter.
Do use `floatingGlass(cornerRadius:)` (Liquid Glass on macOS 26, `.ultraThinMaterial` before) for controls over artwork.
Do honour Reduce Motion: no card lift, no hero auto-advance; the focus ring still shows.
Do keep native controls native (sidebar, pickers, grouped Form, toolbar search) and let them take the graphite accent.
Do put the reason under a disabled Play button in plain words.
donts: Don't use #E50914 for anything but Play: not for "Won't run", errors, focus, headings or brand marks.
Don't give demo values a filled badge; filled means verified.
Don't introduce opaque or tinted grey panels, borders around cards, or resting shadows on cards and panels.
Don't put Liquid Glass or material on panels that sit on the ground.
Don't replace available logo art with typeset names, or set dark logo art straight onto dark artwork.
Don't add a light appearance; the window is dark by design.
Don't convey compatibility with colour alone.
